description: Header file defining the PowerManagerImplementation class, which implements power management functionalities including power state control, notifications, and related controllers within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: PowerManagerImplementation
classes.description: Implements the IPowerManager interface and manages power states, notifications, and controllers within the plugin.

classes.name: LambdaJob
classes.description: A nested class for dispatching lambda functions asynchronously.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers various notification interfaces for power events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters notification interfaces for power events.

methods.name: GetPowerState
methods.description: Retrieves current and previous power states.

methods.name: SetPowerState
methods.description: Sets the power state with a key code and standby reason.

methods.name: Reboot
methods.description: Initiates a system reboot with specified reasons.

methods.name: SetNetworkStandbyMode
methods.description: Enables or disables network standby mode.

methods.name: GetNetworkStandbyMode
methods.description: Retrieves current network standby mode status.

methods.name: onDeepSleepTimerWakeup
methods.description: Notification callback for deep sleep timer wakeup.

methods.name: onDeepSleepUserWakeup
methods.description: Notification callback for user-initiated deep sleep wakeup.

methods.name: onDeepSleepFailed
methods.description: Notification callback when deep sleep fails.

methods.name: onThermalTemperatureChanged
methods.description: Notification callback for thermal temperature changes.
